integrity: The exact positivity proof uses affine-increment sign certificates and an explicit symmetric-data minimax obstruction; numerical checks are supplementary, not proof of uniform claims.
limitations: Four knots, strictly increasing data, homogeneous endpoint derivatives, and reflection-symmetric grids for the mesh-optimality clause only; no general longer-stencil or asymmetrically optimized-grid assertion. Historical priority is provisional.
title: A sharp contrast-four monotonicity threshold for clamped cubic splines
